experience.summary: Platform security and secrets management across cloud and on-prem.
bullets: Architected a self-hosted secrets-management platform (OpenBao) across AWS and on-prem OpenShift, rolled out HA over 3 clusters via ArgoCD
Evaluated SPIFFE/SPIRE workload identity; the recommendation shaped the security roadmap

Dynamic SSH: per-project signed certificates issued at VM boot, replacing static keys
CI/CD automation for cluster, team and workload registration and server bootstrapping

experience.summary: Automation that made bookings faster and content output 5×.

Security-first CI/CD with Trivy and Semgrep
Kong API Gateway rate-limiting for auction close-out spikes
RabbitMQ with a Dead Letter Exchange for scheduling
